title: Quantum Non-Moduler Multiplication with QFT-Based Multi Input Parallelized Adder
summary: In this study, we propose an efficient quantum multiplication approach based on a QFT-assisted parallelized addition scheme. The multiplication stage is implemented using a structure composed entirely of Toffoli gates, which generate partial products. In the second stage, these partial results are accumulated using a QFT-based adder. Unlike conventional QFT-based arithmetic circuits, the proposed design eliminates the repeated application of QFT and inverse QFT (IQFT) operations during intermediate summation processes.
